requirement: Add a price-snapshot store that records opening and closing numbers for every market we originate
how_it_is_met: price_snapshots.csv holds one row per market per snapshot type across all 78 originated markets; price_store_schema.csv documents each slot.
gap_or_caveat: Operator opening and closing numbers are empty and flagged (F-01); MODEL_CLOSE is empty until a second run (F-03).

requirement: Add a verified results feed so backtests and ROI can be computed at all
how_it_is_met: results_feed.csv carries 137 official 2026 finals transcribed week by week from nfl.com, each with its source URL and a UTC retrieval stamp.
gap_or_caveat: It covers one season. Multi-season official results would need the same week-by-week transcription for 1999-2025.

requirement: Originate the side first, then the total, then the moneyline
how_it_is_met: origination_steps.csv records the three steps in order for every game; the moneyline row records that it is derived from the side and the total, never fitted separately.
gap_or_caveat: none - this requirement is met in full

requirement: Publish the model's fair line, the market line and the difference as separate columns
how_it_is_met: originated_markets.csv has model_line, market_line and difference_model_minus_market as three distinct columns for all three market types.
gap_or_caveat: market_line is AGGREGATOR tier with no timestamp (F-14).

requirement: Separate signal from staking in the leaderboard so a lucky staking run cannot mask a bad signal
how_it_is_met: leaderboard.csv ranks each family twice - signal_rank and staking_rank - computed from disjoint inputs, and the staking axis cannot certify or reward anything.
gap_or_caveat: The clearest case on the board today is S7: first on staking from 4 bets, fifth of eight on signal.

requirement: Track the depth of the replacement, not just the fact of a replacement
how_it_is_met: replacement_depth.csv publishes, per position slot, which string steps in (2nd/3rd/4th), whether that replacement is himself on the official injury report, and whether the loss compounds to a third name.
gap_or_caveat: 31 of 32 clubs; Houston publishes no readable chart (F-05). Snapshot is 2026-11-13.

requirement: Compute correlations only from officially sourced numbers and publish n with each value
how_it_is_met: correlations_official.csv publishes 9 pairs with r, p, a 95% interval, n and the definition of n - all computed from nfl.com numbers only.
gap_or_caveat: Everything computed from the mirror is moved to correlations_withheld.csv (F-13).

requirement: Define a demotion gate that sends a live strategy back to paper
how_it_is_met: demotion_gate.csv evaluates six triggers (D1a-D1f) against every family, with the reason each matters and whether it has fired.
gap_or_caveat: No strategy has ever gone live, so no trigger has fired; the gate is armed, not proven.

requirement: Originate my own NFL lines
how_it_is_met: 78 markets across 26 scheduled games (the 13 unplayed Week 10 games and all 13 Week 11 games), priced from a model fitted on 137 official 2026 results.
gap_or_caveat: The totals half of the model does not beat a naive baseline (F-09).

requirement: Research and develop strategies that generate useful signals
how_it_is_met: Nine pre-registered families across singles, parlays and prop combos, graded walk-forward on two universes.
gap_or_caveat: None produces a hit rate above break-even with a deflated Sharpe above the threshold. Two are significantly worse than break-even.

requirement: Treat it as a leaderboard competition that rewards top-performing strategies
how_it_is_met: Two boards, separate signal and staking axes, gates as the entry condition, and a documented reward structure proposal.
gap_or_caveat: No certified entrant, so no reward is payable. Reward funding and jurisdiction are unanswered (Q-04, Q-05).

requirement: Cover single bets, parlays and player prop bet combos
how_it_is_met: Singles (S1-S7), a same-game two-leg parlay (S8) and a prop-combo family (S9) are all on the board and scored.
gap_or_caveat: S9 produced no graded bets: no prop lines exist anywhere in this repo (F-08).

requirement: Each strategy must pass validation gates
how_it_is_met: Nine gates G0-G8 evaluated per family per universe in gate_matrix.csv.
gap_or_caveat: G2 fails for every family because no verified price exists; G1 fails on the certification board for the same reason of sample size.

requirement: Determine correlation values
how_it_is_met: Nine official pairs published with n; the withheld register names and explains every value that is no longer admissible.
gap_or_caveat: none - this requirement is met in full

requirement: Remove luck and build selectively skill-based strategies
how_it_is_met: Shrinkage toward zero, Holm-Bonferroni across families, deflated Sharpe against the family count, out-of-sample-only grading, and a demotion gate.
gap_or_caveat: Luck cannot be removed, only measured. On the samples available today nothing clears the bar, which is the honest output rather than a failure to find one.

requirement: Track injuries and know defensive deficiencies where 2nd, 3rd or 4th string backups replace starters
how_it_is_met: Per-slot tracking of which string steps in, split by offence and defence, cross-checked against the official injury report's Out list.
gap_or_caveat: Game status is empty for 301 of 326 rows at retrieval (F-12).

requirement: The same for offences using starters or backups
how_it_is_met: Offence and defence are separate rows with their own unit column, so the two are never pooled.
gap_or_caveat: none - this requirement is met in full

requirement: Make suggestions to improve the site, with a section where someone can review suggestions and choose the best path before implementing anything
how_it_is_met: suggestions.html publishes every proposal with two or three costed options, a recommended path, and the test that would change the recommendation. All are AWAITING DECISION; none is implemented.
gap_or_caveat: none - this requirement is met in full

requirement: A clear list of questions, information and answers needed before a decision, with suggestions to discover the missing information
how_it_is_met: questions.html splits the register into answered, partially answered and blocking, each with what we have, what is missing and the cheapest way to get it.
gap_or_caveat: Five questions cannot be closed from any public source.

requirement: Create an executive summary outlining the important details
how_it_is_met: executive-summary.html and research/nfl-3fb93d11/EXECUTIVE_SUMMARY.md restate only computed or officially sourced values.
gap_or_caveat: none - this requirement is met in full

requirement: Review the repo line by line against official trusted sources, flag irregularities, no hallucinations
how_it_is_met: audit_repo.py re-checks the existing NFL desks' headline claims against the official pages fetched for this build; repo-audit.html publishes each check with its source.
gap_or_caveat: Only the headline claims are re-checked; a full line-by-line audit of all 1,000+ files is out of scope for one session.

requirement: Create a GitHub Pages site with a clean landing page and subpages organised by category, dashboard-style, tables, all findings
how_it_is_met: A 12-page static dashboard under /nfl-desk-3fb93d11/, generated deterministically and checked for broken links before merge.
gap_or_caveat: none - this requirement is met in full

requirement: Every table row must have a source link to an official site; leave unverifiable values blank and flag them
how_it_is_met: verify.py walks every body-table row in the generated HTML and fails the build if a row has neither an official link nor an explicit blank flag.
gap_or_caveat: Market-line columns link to the mirror, which is an official-grade publisher of nothing - they are labelled AGGREGATOR and flagged (F-14).

requirement: Coordinate with parallel sessions via COORDINATION.md
how_it_is_met: Scope claimed and pushed before implementation; every other session's files are read-only here.
gap_or_caveat: none - this requirement is met in full

requirement: Open a PR, merge autonomously, confirm Pages deploys, record the result
how_it_is_met: The PR, its checks, the merge SHA and the live Pages build are recorded in COORDINATION.md and on this site's sources page.
gap_or_caveat: not assessed in this session
